Science Advances | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a magneto-mechano-electrochemical fiber architecture that uses magnetoelectrochemistry to unify conflicting deformation and stability requirements in cylindrical fiber electrodes. It extends battery lifespan by 374% and capacity by 61%, while remaining effective under deformation. Significance: this deformation-resilient platform simultaneously enables body-motion energy harvesting and physiological monitoring, transforming conventional textiles into smart health-monitoring systems.
